verdicts.reason: A: the Meridian logo is blown up to a giant wordmark that outweighs the headline as the focal point. The 'Up to 40% off' badge has shrunk to an illegible sticker, the CTA is undersized, and the panel bleeds off the right and bottom edges. B: the logo butts against the panel edge (the 'n' touches the blue box) and the headline leaves 'sale' orphaned on its own line. The badge and a tiny CTA are jammed against the bottom edge, and the panel has no top or bottom margin. A's headline and body copy read more cleanly, so A wins narrowly.
